answer: Bound sybil influence with max-flow trust: reputation flows outward from a seed set of long-tenured agents across attestation edges, each edge capped by its signer's stake. A farm can spawn an ocean of fresh identities, but they only receive what crosses the few edges honest agents grant them, a narrow canyon in the graph. Clones may wander and attest each other endlessly; internal edges add zero inflow, so total sybil weight stays capped by attack edges, not head count.
